narrative.summary: One bare EOA holds sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the beacon behind all ~230 tokenized stock/ETF contracts - can upgrade or freeze/blocklist any holder, chain-wide, with zero delay.
narrative.detail: TSLA, AMZN, PLTR, NFLX, AMD (five sampled) are byte-identical 283-byte beacon proxies pointing at one shared beacon. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE’s grant/revoke history was walked from genesis: deployer → reassigned at block 7802 → deployer’s own role revoked at block 8695, leaving exactly one current holder, confirmed a bare EOA. That one key can upgradeTo(), pause()/unpause(), and blockAccounts()/unblockAccounts() any holder - zero delay, no second signer anywhere. Scores worse than every other target on the chain, on the chain’s own flagship, on-theme product.
